title: Invoice Sales Still Clearing on a Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
Sales paid through a Pocketwire invoice clear more slowly on a younger Pocketwire Business Profile. The invoice sales still clearing are every invoice sale dated within the rolling month ending on the handling date for a profile fewer than 12 whole months old, half of those invoice sales rounded down to whole dollars for a profile at least 12 but fewer than 24 whole months old, and none for an older profile. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date. A profile's age in whole months counts a month once the same day of the month as its opening date is reached.

| Age of the profile in whole months | Invoice sales still clearing |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 | all invoice sales of the rolling month |
| 12 to 23 | half of them, rounded down to whole dollars |
| 24 or more | none |

**Worked figures (hypothetical invoice sales of USD 1235.50 in the rolling month).** Profile 7 whole months old: USD 1235.50. Profile 18 whole months old: 617.75, rounded down to USD 617.00. Profile 30 whole months old: none.
